title: A proxy DLL as a whole-client lever: privilege constants, endpoint rewrite, local model gateway
summary: A Qt5 host imports 282 C++ symbols by name, so the auth library can be replaced by a forwarder proxy that stays inside the process. Eleven constant-folding patches open 14 features; four memory patches point the cloud endpoint at a local gateway that speaks OpenAI, Gemini and Anthropic.
